# Popular Mechanics
> Popular Mechanics publishes reporting, reviews, and how-to guidance on science, technology, DIY, automotive, space, military, and modern life.

Popular Mechanics combines news analysis, practical instruction, and product testing to help readers understand and navigate engineering, tools, vehicles, home projects, consumer tech, and scientific discovery.

## Main Sections
- [Home](https://www.popularmechanics.com/): Front page featuring latest stories, reviews, explainers, and how-to coverage across major topics.
- [Technology](https://www.popularmechanics.com/technology/): News and features on gadgets, computing, AI, engineering, and emerging technology.
- [Science](https://www.popularmechanics.com/science/): Coverage of physics, energy, archaeology, math, Earth science, and scientific breakthroughs.
- [Space](https://www.popularmechanics.com/space/): Reporting on rockets, astronomy, planetary science, NASA, and commercial spaceflight.
- [Military](https://www.popularmechanics.com/military/): Defense news and analysis on weapons, aircraft, ships, strategy, and military technology.
- [Cars](https://www.popularmechanics.com/cars/): Automotive news, vehicle reviews, EV coverage, maintenance, and transportation technology.
- [Home](https://www.popularmechanics.com/home/): DIY, home improvement, tools, outdoor equipment, and practical household advice.
- [Product Reviews](https://www.popularmechanics.com/technology/gadgets/): Tested gear, gadgets, and buying advice for consumer products and electronics.

## Technology
- [Technology](https://www.popularmechanics.com/technology/): Main technology hub for digital trends, engineering, gadgets, and innovation coverage.
- [Gadgets](https://www.popularmechanics.com/technology/gadgets/): Reviews and recommendations for consumer electronics, devices, and smart-home gear.
- [Gear](https://www.popularmechanics.com/technology/gear/): Product roundups and tested recommendations for everyday carry and useful equipment.
- [Phones](https://www.popularmechanics.com/technology/gadgets/g2932/best-cell-phone-plans/): Buying-oriented mobile coverage and practical consumer telecom recommendations.
- [Computing](https://www.popularmechanics.com/technology/): Articles on computing trends, software, AI, and digital tools.
- [Engineering](https://www.popularmechanics.com/technology/engineering/): Stories focused on infrastructure, design, machines, and applied engineering.

## Science
- [Science](https://www.popularmechanics.com/science/): Main science section covering discoveries, research, and scientific explanation.
- [Physics](https://www.popularmechanics.com/science/physics/): Articles on fundamental physics, cosmology, and theoretical concepts.
- [Energy](https://www.popularmechanics.com/science/energy/): Reporting on power systems, renewables, grids, and energy technology.
- [Environment](https://www.popularmechanics.com/science/environment/): Coverage of climate, ecosystems, weather, and environmental science.
- [Archaeology](https://www.popularmechanics.com/science/archaeology/): News and features on excavations, ancient history, and new findings.
- [Math](https://www.popularmechanics.com/science/math/): Accessible stories and explainers about mathematics and problem solving.

## Space
- [Space](https://www.popularmechanics.com/space/): Main space hub for astronomy, exploration, rockets, and mission coverage.
- [NASA](https://www.popularmechanics.com/space/nasa/): News and analysis on NASA missions, programs, and spacecraft.
- [Mars](https://www.popularmechanics.com/space/moon-mars/): Coverage of Mars, Moon missions, planetary exploration, and future travel.
- [Astronomy](https://www.popularmechanics.com/space/solar-system/): Stories on planets, telescopes, celestial events, and the solar system.
- [Rockets](https://www.popularmechanics.com/space/rockets/): Reporting on launch systems, propulsion, and commercial spaceflight.
- [Satellites](https://www.popularmechanics.com/space/satellites/): Coverage of orbital systems, communications, imaging, and space infrastructure.

## Military
- [Military](https://www.popularmechanics.com/military/): Main defense section covering weapons, platforms, and military strategy.
- [Weapons](https://www.popularmechanics.com/military/weapons/): Analysis of missiles, firearms, artillery, and advanced weapons systems.
- [Aircraft](https://www.popularmechanics.com/military/aviation/): Coverage of fighters, bombers, helicopters, drones, and military aviation.
- [Navy](https://www.popularmechanics.com/military/navy-ships/): Reporting on warships, submarines, fleets, and maritime defense technology.
- [Army](https://www.popularmechanics.com/military/army/): Stories on land systems, armored vehicles, and ground-force operations.
- [History](https://www.popularmechanics.com/military/history/): Historical military features, retrospectives, and context for current defense topics.

## Cars
- [Cars](https://www.popularmechanics.com/cars/): Main automotive section with reviews, news, maintenance, and transportation features.
- [Car Reviews](https://www.popularmechanics.com/cars/car-reviews/): Vehicle reviews, first drives, and model comparisons.
- [Auto Technology](https://www.popularmechanics.com/cars/car-technology/): Coverage of EVs, autonomy, engines, and in-car technology.
- [Motorcycles](https://www.popularmechanics.com/cars/motorcycles/): News and features on motorcycles, riding gear, and bike technology.
- [Trucks](https://www.popularmechanics.com/cars/trucks/): Pickup and heavy-duty vehicle coverage, reviews, and capability analysis.
- [Maintenance](https://www.popularmechanics.com/cars/how-to/): Practical car care, repair, and ownership how-to articles.

## Home, DIY, and Tools
- [Home](https://www.popularmechanics.com/home/): Main home section for DIY projects, maintenance, and household product advice.
- [DIY](https://www.popularmechanics.com/home/how-to-plans/): Step-by-step projects, plans, repairs, and practical building guidance.
- [Tools](https://www.popularmechanics.com/home/tools/): Tool reviews, buying guides, and workshop equipment recommendations.
- [Lawn and Garden](https://www.popularmechanics.com/home/lawn-garden/): Outdoor maintenance, landscaping, and seasonal yard equipment coverage.
- [Woodworking](https://www.popularmechanics.com/home/how-to-plans/woodworking/): Project ideas, techniques, and tool guidance for woodworking tasks.
- [Home Reviews](https://www.popularmechanics.com/home/tools/gadgets/): Product recommendations for home gear, appliances, and workshop accessories.

## Reviews and Buying Guides
- [Product Reviews](https://www.popularmechanics.com/technology/gadgets/): Central destination for tested products, comparisons, and recommendations.
- [Best Products](https://www.popularmechanics.com/technology/gadgets/g1/best-products/): Roundups highlighting top picks across tech, tools, and everyday gear.
- [Tool Reviews](https://www.popularmechanics.com/home/tools/): Evaluations of drills, saws, hand tools, and workshop essentials.
- [Outdoor Gear](https://www.popularmechanics.com/adventure/outdoors/gadgets/): Buying guides for camping, survival, and outdoor equipment.
- [Automotive Gear](https://www.popularmechanics.com/cars/gadgets/): Recommendations for car accessories, maintenance tools, and driving gear.
- [Gift Guides](https://www.popularmechanics.com/technology/gadgets/gifts/): Curated gift recommendations centered on gadgets, tools, and enthusiast gear.

## Adventure and Outdoors
- [Adventure](https://www.popularmechanics.com/adventure/): Features and gear coverage for outdoor recreation, exploration, and field skills.
- [Outdoors](https://www.popularmechanics.com/adventure/outdoors/): Camping, hiking, survival, and practical outdoor advice.
- [Survival](https://www.popularmechanics.com/adventure/outdoors/how-to/): Skills-based guides for preparedness, safety, and wilderness problem solving.
- [Camping Gear](https://www.popularmechanics.com/adventure/outdoors/gadgets/): Reviews and recommendations for tents, packs, tools, and camp equipment.
- [Boats](https://www.popularmechanics.com/adventure/outdoors/boats/): Coverage of boating, marine gear, and watercraft topics.
- [Flight](https://www.popularmechanics.com/flight/): Aviation-oriented stories on aircraft, pilots, and aerospace technology.

## How-To and Explainers
- [How-To](https://www.popularmechanics.com/home/how-to-plans/): Practical instructional content for repairs, projects, and everyday problem solving.
- [DIY Projects](https://www.popularmechanics.com/home/how-to-plans/): Build guides and step-by-step plans for home and workshop tasks.
- [Car How-To](https://www.popularmechanics.com/cars/how-to/): Maintenance and repair explainers for vehicle owners and enthusiasts.
- [Science Explain-This](https://www.popularmechanics.com/science/): Accessible explainers that break down complex scientific topics.
- [Tech Explain-This](https://www.popularmechanics.com/technology/): Articles clarifying how devices, systems, and digital technologies work.
- [Preparedness Guides](https://www.popularmechanics.com/adventure/outdoors/how-to/): Instructional articles on safety, resilience, and emergency readiness.
